logp.method_description: 'Shake flask' method in octanol-water phase partitions is used to determine the hydrophobicity values of surfactant-ruthenium(II) complexes 1-4 and its precursor complexes ([Ru(bpy)2Cl2] and [Ru(phen)2Cl2]). A small amount of each complex was dissolved in a mixture of water and n-octanol (1:1, 10 mL) followed by shaking for 1 hour. After allowing the mixture to settle over a period of 30 minutes, the resulting two phases were collected separately without cross contamination of one solvent layer into another. By using UV-Vis absorption spectroscopy, the concentration of ruthenium(II) complex in each phase was determined and three independent experiments were performed.
